title: Extreme-Scale Super-Resolution of Homogeneous Turbulence from a Single Realization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Homogeneous turbulent flows exhibit recurring multiscale structures across spatially separated regions, suggesting that a single flow realization may contain sufficient information to learn representations of unresolved scales. We investigate this hypothesis through an extreme super-resolution framework in which a wide-activation deep super-resolution (WDSR) network is trained exclusively on overlapping patches extracted from a single high-resolution turbulent realization. Previously unseen flow fields are reconstructed through patchwise prediction followed by Hann-window-weighted overlap-add assembly. The framework is evaluated for two-dimensional homogeneous isotropic turbulence at super-resolution factors of x32 and x64, representing severe spatial under-resolution. translated_title: 从单一流场实现出发的均匀湍流极端尺度超分辨率重建
translated_abstract: 均匀湍流在空间上相互分离的区域中会呈现出重复出现的多尺度结构，这表明单一流场实现可能包含足够的信息来学习未解析尺度的表示。我们通过一个极端超分辨率框架来验证这一假设：在该框架中，一个宽激活深度超分辨率（WDSR）网络仅使用从单个高分辨率湍流实现中提取的重叠小块进行训练。对于先前未见过的流场，则通过逐块预测并采用汉宁窗加权的重叠相加方法进行拼接重建。该框架在二维均匀各向同性湍流上进行了评估，超分辨率倍数达到32倍和64倍，属于严重的空间欠分辨率情形。尽管训练数据有限，所提出的方法仍能重建相干的涡旋结构，并且比传统的插值方法更准确地恢复细尺度特征。
tldr: 该研究提出一种极端超分辨率框架，仅利用单个高分辨率湍流实现训练WDSR网络，便能在32倍和64倍的严重欠分辨率下准确重建均匀湍流的相干涡结构与细尺度特征。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an extreme super-resolution framework that trains a WDSR network solely on overlapping patches from a single high-resolution turbulent realization, enabling accurate reconstruction of coherent vortical structures and fine-scale features of homogeneous turbulence at severe x32 and x64 under-resolution.
